pure-announcement.rationale: This is the vendor's own milestone post — 'goes Alpha' plus wiring instructions for Polar Signals Cloud and Parca — and it explicitly defers the protocol's substance to the official announcement it links.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts touch OpenTelemetry, profiling, or observability signals.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The alpha status and symbolization limits are checkable against the linked OpenTelemetry announcement and the opentelemetry-ebpf-profiler repo.

durability.rationale: Everything load-bearing is milestone-bound — alpha status, which stacks symbolize on-host today, an unfinished symbol-upload spec — though the fourth-signal idea itself will outlive the post.

actionability.rationale: The steps are product-specific collector-to-Polar-Signals/Parca wiring, and the actual configs were stripped in capture, leaving only pointers to follow.

atomicity.rationale: One subject throughout: running the new OTel profiling signal via the collector's eBPF profiler.
